purpose: Teach: メタデータ/主眼/採る/価額/常設/工学科/多面/製作所

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、書類のメタデータ的な管理を徹底された
lines.en: When Father founded the company, he was rigorous about documentation and record-keeping.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Warm respect underscoring each phrase. Slow pace that honors the memory. Voice carries the weight of years of observation, not heaviness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営の主眼をお客様に置かれた
lines.en: Yes. Father always kept the customer at the center of everything.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Light emphasis on the word 'customer' — not lecturing, just marking what mattered to his father. Warm, present tone. Eye contact implied in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海外人材を採る決断をされたぞ
lines.en: And he made the bold decision to hire talent from overseas, you know.
lines.style: Slight lift of pride in the voice. Thoughtful pace. The 'you know' lands as shared understanding, not explanation. Quiet wonder at the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品の価額交渉に長けてらした
lines.en: Yes. Father had a gift for negotiating product pricing.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment. Gentle emphasis on 'gift' — recognizing a specific skill with understated appreciation. Warm, measured delivery. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本社に常設のショールームを作られた
lines.en: He had the foresight to build a permanent showroom at headquarters.
lines.style: Nostalgic warmth. Slight upward inflection on 'showroom' — a concrete example of vision made real. Pace is unhurried, honoring the decision. Soft trailing tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは工学科出身の社員を信頼された
lines.en: Yes. Father placed enormous trust in the engineers on his team.
lines.style: Firm but warm affirmation. Light emphasis on 'trust' — the weight of that choice. Steady voice, grounded in fact. Speaks to the character of both his father and his own values.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、多面的な視点で経営判断をされたぞ
lines.en: He approached management decisions from so many angles at once.
lines.style: Voice rises slightly with quiet admiration. 'So many angles' lands with genuine wonder. Slower pace. The tone carries both awe and the years spent watching this unfold.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは製作所の現場に頻繁に足を運ばれた
lines.en: Yes. He spent time on the factory floor regularly, staying close to the work.
lines.style: Warm closing affirmation. Gentle emphasis on 'regularly' — marking a habit, a character trait. Voice settles into respect. Ends with quiet dignity, grounded and present.
